Thanks Evan — this looks good. Welcome aboard! Quick internal note copied so owners are visible to Pulsefront and to keep single-threaded correspondence. Below is the initial handoff plan and who will own what from Redwood: 

- Marissa Cole (CS Lead) — day-to-day onboarding, acceptance criteria owner, training sessions.
- Karthik Iyer (Implementation Lead) — technical intake, environment setup, runbooks.
- Ben Carter (Account Exec, escalation) — contract/packaging and SLA confirmation.
- Me (Lauren) — program oversight and milestone sign-offs until 30d post-go-live.

Proposed kickoff: Tuesday, June 8 at 09:00 PT (we'll hold 60 minutes). If June 8 is tight for your team, say the word and we'll move to June 9.

Prep checklist for Pulsefront (please confirm you can provide these before kickoff):
- VPN or bastion host details + tech contact for approvals
- Network egress diagram (we'll need ports and IP ranges)
- Test dataset (anonymized) and sample requests for throughput profiling
- PO or signed SOW for procurement to finalize billing cadence

I've attached a short Handoff Checklist and an internal timeline (PDF stub) to this message for Marissa/Karthik to action.

Attachments: PF_network_egress_diagram.pdf (pdf)

Marissa and Karthik — please reply with proposed owner-level milestones and any pre-kickoff blockers by EOD Monday, May 10. Evan/Melody — I'll hold the tentative June 8 slot until I hear back.

Thanks — saw the checklist. Quick visibility on milestones from implementation + CS side: 

Pre-kickoff (May 10–Jun 7)
- Karthik: environment validation (network rules, egress, test endpoint) — target complete by Jun 1
- Marissa: onboarding plan + training slate, identify 3 power users for pilot — target complete by Jun 3
- Ben: confirm PO and billing cadence; flag any procurement lead times 

Kickoff week (Jun 7–11)
- Day 0: alignment call (stakeholders, runbook review, acceptance criteria)
- Day 1–7: test integration and iterate on tokenization/throughput thresholds

Post-kick (0–30 days)
- Weekly CS check-ins, quality monitoring, model steering if regressions observed

Blockers we see today:
- Need Pulsefront network egress diagram with CIDR ranges (we currently have a high-level note).
- We will require a technical contact to approve VPN access (Melody — can you confirm?).

I'll draft the milestone sheet and share a short runbook for the kickoff (ETA: Tue, May 11). If anyone wants to split the Day 1 checklist into smaller deliverables, say so now — otherwise I'll assume the above cadence.
